description: 8 should-trigger + 5 should-not-trigger queries. Should-trigger covers DE + EN phrasings of discounted-cash-flow valuation: WACC, terminal value, FCFF projection, sensitivity grid, counter-modelling a seller's deck. Should-not-trigger covers neighbours: runway, unit economics, series forecasting, workbook formatting alone, and a buy/sell call.

queries.q: build a DCF for this SaaS company with a 5-year FCFF projection
what is this business worth on a discounted cash flow basis?
mach mir eine DCF-Bewertung für das Unternehmen
compute the WACC and terminal value for this valuation
give me a WACC x terminal growth sensitivity grid
what discount rate does the seller's IRR imply?
Unternehmenswert per Discounted Cash Flow mit Sensitivitätsanalyse
how many months of runway do we have at current burn?
what is our LTV to CAC ratio?
